additions.name: Digital Realty Athens Campus — ATH1, ATH2 and ATH3 data-centre operations

status.summary: On 7 September 2026 Digital Realty Hellas finally submitted, in the state OPS-ADE system, a modified operation notification for data centres at Ifestou 72-76, 'Bota' BIOPA Koropi (action 586011), which the Region of Attica published on 8 September. It notifies the operation of data centres ATH1 (2,053 kW IT), ATH2 (2,000 kW) and ATH3 (6,863.16 kW), together with ATH4 (6,800.04 kW), providing services to third parties. The Region's PPD decision of September describes ATH-1 to ATH-4 as existing buildings, and Digital Realty lists ATH1, ATH2 and ATH3 as its Athens campus data centres. This supports ATH1-ATH3 operating as of 7 September 2026. ATH4's opening is not established here, and the filing states no utilisation or load in service.

locator.precision: Installation coordinate registered in the state OPS-ADE operation-notification record of Digital Realty Hellas for Ifestou 72-76, 'Bota' BIOPA Koropi, whose modification covers ATH1-ATH4. It locates the campus, not a particular building, entrance or parcel boundary.
locator.identity_review: Both OPS-ADE printouts (584789 of 4 September and 586011 of 7 September 2026) register the same installation, 'DIGITAL REALTY (ATH3) (ΚΡΩΠΙΑΣ)', at Ifestou 72-76 'Bota' BIOPA Koropi with latitude 37.87155141033321 and longitude 23.870614305559798, transcribed exactly. Digital Realty's own facility pages place ATH1/ATH2 at Ifestou 76 (37.871610, 23.870226) and ATH3 at Ifestou 74 (37.872271, 23.869798); the register point lies 34.8 m east-south-east of the ATH1/ATH2 point and 107.4 m south-east of the ATH3 point (geodesic, pyproj), consistent with one campus spanning Ifestou 72-76. The address and operator match the PPD decision for the existing buildings ATH-1 to ATH-4.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The register states no datum or positional accuracy; the coordinate is read as WGS84, consistent with the operator's independent web-map points 34.8 m and 107.4 m away, which are themselves 82.5 m apart. The campus extent is not published; decimal places are not accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Sites, projects, evidence, source records and the identity mapping of 2026-10-23-research-fortyfifth (596 sites, 631 projects, 3,225 evidence rows, 231 source records and the identity mapping) were searched for Digital Realty Hellas, Lamda Hellix, Koropi/Κορωπί, Kropia/Κρωπία, Ifestou/Ηφαίστου, Athens/Αθήνα and ATH1-ATH4: there is no match. No Atlas site or project lies within 2 km of the point; the nearest site is Ten Brinke Spata Data Center (11.05 km north-north-east, a different developer's project at Agiou Dimitriou, Spata), then ENKA EDS IST 01 Tuzla (572.9 km). No pending queue fragment or claim names Digital Realty Athens, Koropi or Ifestou, and none lies within 2 km. The only hold that names this campus is the 2026-10-16 thirty-first eastern_europe hold for ATH4 (an unopened fourth building); ATH4 is not admitted here and can later be added as a project on this site. The Region of Attica's separate notifications for Data4 Greece (13 July 2026) and Unisystems (27 July 2026) concern other operators and fall before the 85-day floor. Re-screened at verification on 23 October 2026 against the newer current dataset 2026-10-23-research-fortysixth (601 sites, 636 projects; sites, projects, evidence, source records and identity mapping), all other queue fragments and sources/*-holds.json: still no name, alias, operator, address or coordinate match; the nearest site remains Ten Brinke Spata Data Center (11.03 km geodesic).
additions.successor_review: The Region of Attica post sitemaps covering 30 June to 22 October 2026 (post-sitemap69-71, captured 23 October) list no later Digital Realty notification, cessation or modification after the 8 September notifications and the 14 September PPD decision. Digital Realty's English press-release sitemap (captured 23 October; newest item 7 October 2026) has no Athens release after 2025, and its Athens metro page still lists ATH1-ATH3 only. The 2026-10-16 hold records a 29 September summit statement that ATH4 was ready and expected to be inaugurated in October or November; that is a forecast and is not used. Keep 7 September 2026 as the operating observation for ATH1-ATH3; no expansion, ATH4 opening or capacity in service is asserted.
